D.treatment: Python and Jupyter Notebook data-analysis module

O.outcome_detail: views of the importance of computational skills

cells.quote: It is remarkable that students' already positive views on the importance of computational skills not only remained consistent but even improved between the pre-survey and the post-survey (see figure 2).
cells.note: The study used matched pre- and post-course surveys; there was no separate control group.

D.treatment: second experiment after additional Python practice
D.comparison: first experiment after the introductory Python sessions

O.outcome_detail: use of Python and Jupyter Notebooks for data analysis

cells.quote: Even if the use of Python and JN was not mandatory, 83% of student groups used Python and JNs for their data analysis in the first experiment and 100% in the second experiment. These results indicate an increase in students’ confidence and proficiency in using these tools.
cells.note: This was an observational comparison of successive laboratory experiments, not a randomized comparison.
